design_principles: Generous spacing to let content breathe
High contrast with soft glowing accents
Use glassmorphism for premium feel on cards/headers

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento grids with gap-8 to gap-12, mixed spans for asymmetry.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build as a single page application with distinct sections using standard React (.js/.jsx format, NOT TypeScript).
Use framer-motion heavily for scroll reveals, staggering elements in bento grids, and pulsing backgrounds.
Ensure all text has adequate contrast against the dark backgrounds. Use text-shadow if placed over the purple mesh gradient.
For the hero background, place the `hero_bg_glow` image absolutely behind the content with object-cover and opacity-40, combined with a radial gradient to blend it into the dark background.
Implement the Header with `backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/50 border-b border-white/10` so it acts as crystal glass when scrolling.
For buttons, add a subtle glowing box-shadow that intensifies on hover.
Never use purely flat gray or black (#000000 or #808080); tint them slightly with purple/blue (#05050A).
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) in Duotone variant for features and UI elements.
MUST implement `data-testid` on all interactive and key informational elements (buttons, links, form inputs, menus, error messages, user balances, confirmation text).
Do NOT use typical Shadcn Card components without stripping the 'Vercel-look'. Customize them heavily with the defined `surfaces.card` styles.
Ensure the hero iPhone mockups are large and prominent. Use floating animations (translateY keyframes) to make them feel alive.
Ensure generous padding using Tailwind utilities like py-24 or py-32 for section separation.
Use React Fast Marquee for the Testimonials sliding section.
